highlights_headline: This unreleased update improves rendering responsiveness, memory use, and WebGPU distribution across supported platforms.
highlights_body: It synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh, reduces allocations in image and text-shaping paths, packages the WebGPU implementation into the native library, and corrects front-buffered stream retention.

bullets.detail: Coordinates texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother Android output.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily
bullets.detail: Corrects stream retention so buffered input can be released when it is no longer needed.
Optimizes managed image pixel copies and avoids unnecessary native allocations when decoding HarfBuzz feature strings.

bullets.lead: WebGPU implementation packaged with the native library
bullets.detail: Ships the WebGPU implementation in libSkiaSharp.a so native consumers receive the required rendering support with the library.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Packaged the WebGPU implementation with the native SkiaSharp library
